title: EU moves to tighten AI oversight
overview: Lawmakers advanced new supervisory duties for high-risk AI systems, while industry groups warned about compliance costs.

highlights.text: Parliament backed stricter supervision of high-risk AI systems, adding reporting duties for providers operating in the single market.
Industry associations disputed the timeline, arguing that smaller providers cannot meet the proposed conformity deadlines.

sourceArticles.title: Parliament backs stricter AI supervision
sourceArticles.description: Lawmakers approved additional duties for providers of high-risk AI systems.

sourceArticles.title: Industry warns over AI compliance deadlines
sourceArticles.description: Trade bodies said the proposed timeline is unworkable for smaller providers.
